name: xobin-source
description: Xobin TypeScript libraries for exact dates, times, calendars and culture-aware formatting.
author: DoctorCode Team

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @xobin/core && npm run build --workspace @xobin/globalization
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && npm run test:unit
scripts.release:pack: npm run build && node tools/release.mjs pack
scripts.release:prepare: npm test && npm run check:generated && npm run test:browser && npm run test:packed && npm run test:size && npm run release:check
